xmldoc.short_description: Convert RGB color values to HSV color values.

param_input_item.param_description: m-by-n-by-3 RGB image with class double, single, uint8, or uint16.
Double RGB colormap with values in the range [0, 1].

param_output_item.param_description: HSV image. The output is single only when the input image is single; otherwise it is double.
HSV colormap with the same number of rows as map.

description.p: Convert RGB color values to HSV color values. RGB images must be real double, single, uint8, or uint16 arrays. Floating-point RGB image values are converted without clipping. Empty RGB images preserve their size.
A double RGB colormap with values in [0, 1] is converted row by row.

example_item.example_item_description: Display hue channel from RGB to HSV conversion
